onboarding.tour.title: Take the tour
onboarding.tour.p1.title: Drop a file
onboarding.tour.p1.body: Open CSV, Parquet, JSON or SQLite — or just drag one in. No import wizard, no waiting.
onboarding.tour.p2.title: Explore fast
onboarding.tour.p2.body: Sort, filter, and edit millions of rows at 60 fps. Your edits are instant and non-destructive.
onboarding.tour.p3.title: Know your data
onboarding.tour.p3.body: Every table is auto-profiled — distributions, null rates, top values, and full lineage — right in the Inspector.
onboarding.tour.p4.title: SQL, or plain English
onboarding.tour.p4.body: Write DuckDB SQL with autocomplete, or ask in plain English and let AI draft the query. You always review before it runs.
onboarding.tour.p5.title: See it
onboarding.tour.p5.body: Turn any result into a bar, line, or scatter chart in a click. Export as PNG.
onboarding.tour.p6.title: Go to the cloud
onboarding.tour.p6.body: Connect your MotherDuck account to query cloud DuckDB right beside your local tables.
onboarding.tour.p7.title: Private by default
onboarding.tour.p7.body: Everything runs locally. AI is bring-your-own-key and off until you add one — your data and keys stay on your machine.
